title: Snow Clouds: How Fluffy Clouds Turn Into Soft Snowflakes!

lines.text: Rain, rain, go away, come again another day!
lines.caps: Rain, rain, go *AWAY, | come again another *DAY!

lines.text: But when winter temperatures drop below freezing, rain turns into magical snow!
lines.caps: But when winter temperatures drop below *FREEZING, | rain turns into magical *SNOW!

lines.text: How does invisible vapor floating in fluffy clouds turn into soft white snowflakes?
lines.caps: How does invisible vapor floating in fluffy *CLOUDS | turn into soft white *SNOWFLAKES?

lines.text: High in the cold sky, clouds are filled with freezing water vapor and tiny floating dust!
lines.caps: High in the cold *SKY, | clouds are filled with freezing water vapor and tiny *FLOATING | *DUST!

lines.text: When the temperature dips below thirty-two degrees Fahrenheit, magic happens!
lines.caps: When the temperature dips below *THIRTY-TWO | degrees Fahrenheit, magic *HAPPENS!

lines.text: Water vapor skips turning into rain and crystalizes directly into solid ice!
lines.caps: Water vapor skips turning into *RAIN | and crystalizes directly into solid *ICE!

lines.text: Billions of tiny ice crystals group together into soft, puffy snowflakes!
lines.caps: Billions of tiny ice *CRYSTALS | group together into soft, puffy *SNOWFLAKES!

lines.text: When they become too heavy for the cloud to hold, they gently float down to Earth!
lines.caps: When they become too heavy for the cloud to *HOLD, | they gently float down to *EARTH!

lines.text: Snow into more fun science and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
lines.caps: *SNOW into more | fun *SCIENCE and | *SUBSCRIBE to | *BABYBEATS Rhymo!
